about_the_game:
🧵 Atelier da Tete: Patches - DEMO ✨

This demo showcases Atelier da Tete, a cozy game where you customize clothes and accessories. Experience the main mechanics in a limited version that offers a complete preview of the full experience! 🎨

What's included in this demo: 

Available Clothes & Accessories: 👕

Limited selection of shirts, jackets, and accessories for customization

Representative models from the complete catalog

Customization Tools: 🎭

Basic color palette for styling

Reduced set of decorative shapes

Selection of exclusive patches for application

Free positioning system

Demonstrated Mechanics: ⚙️

Special sewing machine finishing animation

Shop system with customer bidding

Main navigation interface and menus

How it works in the demo: 🌟

Choose & Customize 🖌️ - Select one of the available clothes and use the included colors, shapes, and patches to create your unique design.

Finishing Touch ✂️ - Watch the sewing machine animation that highlights the final touch of your creation.

Limited Sales 💰 - Test the shop system where customers bid on your customizations. You can accept offers or decline to explore new combinations.

This demo offers an authentic experience of the customization and selling mechanics, showcasing the hand-drawn art style and cozy atmosphere of the complete game in a compact format! 🏠💕

short_description: Tete received a patch customization machine from her grandmother and now transforms every piece of clothing into something special! Unleash your creativity, create unique pieces in the demo, and sell them in the in-game store.
